CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a slow dolly-in that closes about a third of the distance on a 35mm reportage, framing with frame-within-frame using foreground architecture.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with flickering firelight as the only motivated source; grade as a cinematic grade with a warm key and green-leaning ambient shadows. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.
